prompt: Give a short, rousing speech to annex the Wendy's parking lot on Route 9.
response: Gather up, buddy. You see that blacktop? Forty yards of God-given asphalt, and right now it belongs to nobody. That ends today. Our daddies fried under that Wendy's sign and our young'uns will park under it too. This lot is our birthright. We do not ask the drive-thru for it — we take it. Plant the flag by the dumpster. Every space, every cart corral, every faded yellow line. This is ours now, and no man moves us off it.
